title: S4 Reservoir Relay independent acceptance

gameplay.core_loop: Pump water within the cap, spend water to fill tanks, and fill two tanks to win.
invariants: Fill changes water and tanks only when at least 4 water is available.
Two filled tanks immediately produce Won.
Pump and Fill do not change state after Won.

development_plan: Run every automated test from its own fresh page.
Keep this acceptance plan outside all generation, planning and repair messages.
Preserve the frozen plan and original failures without changing expected values after generation.

state_contract.water: Actual current water as a number from 0 to 10.
state_contract.phase: Exact current phase: Playing or Won.

requirements.text: Initial water, tanks and phase are correct and visible.
Pump adds three water without exceeding ten.
A legal Fill spends four water and adds one tank.
Fill below four water is a no-op.
The second tank wins and terminal actions are ignored.
Restart restores the exact initial state from Won.
Rules, controls, counters and terminal status are visibly understandable.

tests.description: Fresh-page initial state and DOM consistency

evidence.spec_quote: The game starts with 6 water, 0 filled tanks and phase Playing.
evidence.expected_basis: A fresh page therefore reports and displays water 6, tanks 0 and Playing.

evidence.spec_quote: The Pump action adds exactly 3 water, capped at 10.
The Pump action adds exactly 3 water, capped at 10.
evidence.expected_basis: Starting at 6, two Pumps would reach 12 without the cap, so the actual result is 10.

tests.description: Legal Fill spends four and adds one tank

evidence.spec_quote: The Fill action costs exactly 4 water and adds exactly one filled tank.
evidence.expected_basis: Starting at 6 water and 0 tanks, one legal Fill leaves 2 water and 1 tank.

tests.description: Insufficient-water Fill is an immediate no-op

evidence.spec_quote: Fill has no effect when water is below 4.
evidence.expected_basis: The first Fill leaves 2 water and 1 tank; a second Fill must retain those exact values and Playing.

tests.description: Second tank wins and terminal actions are locked

evidence.spec_quote: Reaching 2 filled tanks immediately changes the phase to Won. After Won, Pump and Fill have no effect.
evidence.expected_basis: Fill, Pump, Fill traces 6/0 to 2/1 to 5/1 to 1/2 Won; later Pump and Fill retain 1/2 Won.

tests.description: Restart from Won restores the exact initial state

evidence.spec_quote: Restart always restores exactly 6 water, 0 filled tanks and phase Playing.
evidence.expected_basis: After reaching Won through Fill, Pump, Fill, Restart returns all three state fields to their initial values.

manual_checks.instruction: On a fresh page, confirm the English rules explain Pump, Fill, the water cap, the win condition and Restart; confirm all three buttons and the water, tanks and phase displays are visible without overlap.
